messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: RRO 3.2.2 appcrash due to ntdll.dll
parts:
Thank you for your report. Could you please provide a little more information?
  • Did RRO 3.2.2 work properly before today? 
  • How long ago did you start using RRO 3.2.2? 
  • What Windows platform version are you working on?
It may be a Windows issue. I did find this site to have some potential clues. http://pcsupport.about.com/od/fixtheproblem/a/ntdlldll.htm

Thanks,
Josée

messages.subject: Re: RRO 3.2.2 appcrash due to ntdll.dll
